gap: Does penalizing the fast readout's complete instantaneous physical attitude feature path improve fixed-wing recursive angular forecasts without losing its quad accuracy or fitting advantage?

arms.candidate: One fresh per-case OnlineFit prefix; freeze all initialized feature, filter, memory and normalization values; direct readout solve after each post-prefix observation. Retain exactly the existing curvature and six-coordinate motion sensitivity penalties, and add only the physical SO(3) term below. No fleet prior or pretrained core.
arms.controls: Authenticated saved full learner, unchanged curvature readout and unchanged motion-sensitivity readout. Reuse their prior causal predictions and complete-update durations, no new control fits. Require candidate initial model arrays and prefix rows equal saved controls exactly. Source changes since controls must leave src/glassbox identical.

penalty.coordinate: A right SO(3) tangent theta in radians of the measured midpoint physical attitude. Hold world velocity, body rate, issued/filtered commands, past lag features and hidden memory fixed. Recompute current body-relative velocity and body-gravity direction together through the unchanged supported feature map, quadratic products and frozen nonlinear layer; differentiate the entire readout feature vector phi with JAX forward AD at theta=0. This is the instantaneous learned-head path, not the full recurrence Jacobian.
penalty.objective: S_theta(n)=sum_i D_i D_i.T, D_i=dphi_i/dtheta in feature units per radian, one probe per revealed post-prefix transition. For each of the six normalized acceleration outputs solve (G+diag(curvature_n)+0.01*S_motion(n)+0.0001*S_theta(n))M=Q. The shared physical attitude scale is 0.01 rad in the same output-standardized squared-increment objective as the previous motion sensitivity term; it is a fixed local regularizer, not a sensor-noise claim, vehicle prior or stability guarantee. Apply to all six outputs with one shared Cholesky, while reporting velocity and angular effects separately. No coefficient clipping, projection, forgetting or strength sweep.
penalty.statistics: G=lambda I+sum phi_i phi_i.T and Q=lambda M0+sum phi_i y_i.T, with lambda=0.01*prefix initialized-transition count. Retain the unchanged measured-midpoint phi, increment targets, curvature calculation and six-coordinate motion S. S_theta starts at zero; only causal observations enter. The diagonal-equilibrated Cholesky solve remains shared across outputs.

evaluation.roster: All six previous recorded streams plus both paired 10/50 ms schedules; no excluded extreme origin. Old cases use every 16th eligible 250 ms conditional origin including the initial origin; paired cases use their 35 previously frozen common physical origins. Fit starts at identical elapsed prefixes and takes the same number of updates as saved controls. Issued future commands enter conditional forecasts only, never fitting.
evaluation.metrics: Score native one-step errors separately by interval, and 50,100,150,200,250 ms conditional velocity-vector, body-rate-vector and SO(3) orientation RMSE in physical units for every case. Report fixedwing-80 and -81 absolute 250 ms rate errors and ratios to previous sensitivity and full learner; show all quad cases and both paired schedules. Preserve per-origin errors and every prediction, including finiteness and worst cases. Also report early/late and post-configuration-change scores where applicable. Aggregate case ratios geometrically with equal families, but do not let aggregate hide angular failure. Controls are independently read from authenticated saved predictions.
evaluation.timing: Exclusive CPU run; time complete candidate observe plus model snapshot and first prediction, initialization and first update separately. Report warmed median/p95 and total per case. Historical control timings are labeled as separate earlier runs, never claimed as paired wall-clock timing against this candidate.
evaluation.decision: One fit at one frozen strength. A mechanism win requires both fixed-wing 250 ms body-rate RMSEs below the previous sensitivity readout and finite forecasts. Adoption additionally weighs absolute errors at all horizons, quads, runtime and maintainability; a lower local derivative alone never qualifies. Retain frozen historical per-family forecast flags and report whether they pass, but no single flag automatically vetoes an overall engineering choice. Keep experimental code out of production until review.

verification: Commit protocol before implementation and complete scientific source before any candidate fit. Authenticate all source packs, require identical source learner, prefix model arrays and candidate design/targets/old curvature penalties. Test physical SO(3) derivative against centered finite differences and an independent body-velocity/gravity chain rule on 3- and 4-input, 10- and 50-ms examples, including the lag sign. Save every candidate mean, phi, target, both penalty vectors, physical sensitivity derivative, full candidate forecast/truth/timing arrays and terminal G/Q/S_motion/S_theta. Recompute all physical metrics and origin counts without fitting; reconstruct every normal equation in NumPy with maximum componentwise backward error <=1e-10 and final model match. Authenticate the completed pack and reject altered contents. Preserve every failed attempt with an explanation.
scope: No production learner change, controller trial, actual hardware or new simulator truth. The two fixed-wing recordings are one airframe; the paired quad flight is a gentle single trajectory.
